name: web-with-worker
title: Web application with worker
description: An HTTP service and a background worker that use the same image and settings. The worker starts with the argument "worker".

parameters.name: image
parameters.title: Image
parameters.description: Image in the registry project of the tenant.

parameters.name: port
parameters.title: Port
parameters.description: The port where the web program listens.

parameters.name: health_path
parameters.title: Health check path
parameters.description: The path that answers 2xx or 3xx when the web program is ready.

parameters.name: host
parameters.title: Public host name
parameters.description: Optional. If you set it, the web service is available from outside the cluster at this name.

parameters.name: env
parameters.title: Environment variables
parameters.description: One NAME=value on each line, for both components. Do not put secrets here.
